title: Cross-provider runtime configuration

sections.title: Can I apply the cross-provider configuration now?
paragraphs: No. At this intermediate-level review stage, do not apply provider-specific runtime changes from this resource. The supported providers, configuration mechanism, accepted values, precedence rules, validation behavior, failure modes, and recovery procedures are UNKNOWN.

The supported general principle is to keep configuration that varies between deployments separate from application code. This principle does not establish which mechanism or values any provider accepts, so it cannot substitute for the missing provider documentation.
sections.callout: Do not guess configuration names or values. Obtain the existing guide, its cited documentation, and applicable first-party specifications before making a runtime change.
